text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S suffered a major injury,
so 
she was immediately treated in the 
infirmary.

It seems even this much...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Symboli Kris S's injury has 
worsened.
She stopped immediately and took 
time off to rest...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...With this level of load—it's no 
problem. Next—let's use the machines.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
There will likely be delays to the plan. 
However—they should be kept to a minimum.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Continuing with light training at this 
pace, Symboli Kris S made a smooth and 
successful comeback.
